title: Reusable and versatile
text: Reusable and versatile. This was a great purchase with lots of versatility in how you can use it, bunting, banner etc. We ended up using over a swing chair as the birthday girls' rainbow throne. It was adorable and very easily reusable! Would buy again

features: Our garlands are handmade, each one is unique in it's own way, no two are ever identical.
This garland has approximately 32 meters of ribbon. That's a lot of fabric! 40 inch (Long) x 14 inch (Tall).THE FINISHED GARLAND MEASURES 1 METER IN LENGTH, FROM END TO END APPROX.
Inspired by rainbows,this stunning garland features a gorgeous verity of bright, and vivid shades. Perfect to brighten up and day, room or event.
Rainbows are very unisex, so this is the perfect colour for both boys and girls alike.
Perfect for Special Events - Wedding ceremony stage,bridal shower, baby shower, birthday parties, graduations,retirement parties, engagement photos,doorways. home decor, photography prop.
description: Looking for a garland? Want something colourful and fun? Love handmade? Well look no further!
All my garlands are lovingly handmade.
Garlands can be used in many different settings, to add luxury, charm, texture, colour or interest to your home, wedding, baby shower, nursery, party venue or camper van. The options are limitless!
- Drape above an entry way or door way to welcome your guests.
- Hang with a matching Birthday Banner.
- Pair with a matching Highchair Banner.
- Use as a Photo Booth Backdrop.
- Can even be used as a Monthly Photo Garland. Simply clip your photos to it!
- Wear around your waist if you want!
The ribbons can be moved along the string. You can also tighten any strands on your garland by gently pulling the string or ribbon.
If your garland is going to be used outdoors, I would only recommend doing this in dry and mild conditions, as it may damage your garland.
